lemmas.primary_translation: completely motionless / stiff as a post

definitions.translation: completely motionless (lit. stiff as a support or post)

examples.no: offiseren stod stiv som en støtte på brua
examples.en: the officer stood as stiff as a post on the bridge

examples.no: hun ble stiv som en støtte da hun så ham
examples.en: she went as stiff as a post when she saw him
